scope: 192 historical immutable parent/20k checkpoints; fresh diagnostics only, no persistent policy update; automatic execution authorized by remaining-candidate request.
banks: Fresh D, disjoint physical/task-parameter/seed hashes from historical evaluation and training. Same20 cases per task across all checkpoints within suite. Unused outcome4 cases generated by unchanged bank helper are recorded and excluded from other banks.
deterministic: All500 steps even after success; record reward and official success/near_object/grasp_success/obj_to_target at every step. Semantics retained per task: grasp_success is constant1 on DC/WO/WC; BP means gripper open. Never pool as a universal grasp event.

MC.definition: Q(s0,a0) at fixed deterministic a0. First reward without entropy; t1..499 follow frozen stochastic policy, sum gamma^t*(reward-alpha*logpi). Timeout tail gamma^500*mean_a[min(current twinQ)-alpha logpi] from16 action draws. Fixed snapshot alpha. Separate tail-free return and tail contribution, sampling SE across4 rollouts.
MC.limits: 500-step bootstrapped estimate, not exact infinite-horizon value. Tail is biased by current Q; report magnitude and no-tail sensitivity. Two initial states/task only; sample error must be reported. No resetting or termination at success.

prediction: Same retrospective20k->40k, held-original-seed, D50/O50 outcome split, lambda1 weighted-mean-loss ridge, A/B/C balanced as v29. New D diagnostics are additional inputs, measured before old40k outcome.
calibration: Per task ridge linear probability return->success model fitted on new D episodes from training original seeds only, with intercept and standardized return; lambda1 slope penalty, predictions clipped[0,1]. Parent and20k checkpoints, each checkpoint/task equally weighted. No outcome40k calibration labels. Task identity used for calibration only; allocation predictor uses focus/other summaries.
models: CriticBase frozen full marginal+F05 critic controls. SuccessBase adds new D parent and20k success focus/other. RawReturn adds task-fold-standardized current-minus-parent return focus/other. CalibratedReturn adds calibrated-success change minus actual new-D success change focus/other. RolloutBase=SuccessBase+MC target RMS and MC mean SE focus/other. RolloutValue adds normalized abs(Q-MCmean) focus/other. NearObject adds new-D official near-object reached fraction focus/other, supplementary F03 only.
primary_screen: same-repeat gain>=1pp, at least2 positive original seeds, no group below-2pp. No confirmatory or same40k-total-budget claim.
costs: Each snapshot80 deterministic500-step episodes+32 MC500-step episodes=56000 new diagnostic steps; total10.752M. Training0. Early-stop and500-step returns never merged. Existing F05 measurements reused as historical controls; online deployment measurement costs remain additional.
